output_path.description: Path where the archive will be written. Format determined by file suffix (e.g., .bin, .tar.gz, .raw). Required. Defaults to care-<DATE>.bin or care-<DATE>.raw.

concealed_paths.description: List of additional paths to conceal (beyond $HOME and /tmp). Use only if needed.

revealed_paths.description: List of paths to reveal explicitly if nested in concealed paths (e.g., $PWD or specific config dirs). $PWD is revealed by default unless -d.

volatile_paths.description: Paths to exclude from archiving; reuse actual paths at re-execution. Includes standard volatile paths like pseudo-filesystems, sockets, and auth files.

volatile_env.description: Environment variables to exclude from archiving; reuse actual values at re-execution.

max_archivable_size_mb.description: Maximum file size (MB) to archive; larger files are truncated to 0 bytes. Negative = no limit. Default 1GB unless -d.

verbose.description: Debug verbosity level (0=quiet, higher=more verbose). Negative = quiet except fatal errors.

ignore_default_config.description: If true, disable all default concealed/revealed/volatile paths and env vars (equivalent to -d/--ignore-default-config).
